content.text: Instagram down today? Thousands say they can’t reply to friendsInstagram users worldwide experienced significant issues on Wednesday morning, with many unable to send or reply to messages. The outage primarily affected direct messaging, with over 10,000 users reporting problems, predominantly in the United States. The platform has not yet confirmed the widespread disruption.Instagram Down? Thousands across major US cities report issues, Downdetector showsInstagram Down? Thousands of Instagram users reported widespread issues with direct messaging on Wednesday, March 10, 2026. Many users were unable to send or receive messages, with reports concentrated in major US cities. The disruption primarily affected the app's messaging feature, leaving users frustrated as Meta Platforms' official status page showed no known issues.Instagram down right now? Downdetector shows thousands reporting website issuesInstagram Down? Instagram users reported widespread outages on Wednesday, January 4, with thousands of issues logged on Downdetector. Many users encountered an error message when attempting to access the platform. While reports indicated problems primarily with the website, Instagram has not yet confirmed the outage or provided details.Meta says working to fix Instagram outageThe user reports were as high as 24,000 earlier, said Downdetector, which tracks outages by collating status reports from a number of sources including user-submitted errors on its platform.Instagram down: several users in India report outageThe outage began Wednesday morning, locking users out of the app, according to Downdetector, an online platform that provides users with real-time information about the status of various websites and services.Whatsapp, Instagram, and Facebook down globallyFacebook Whatsapp Instagram Outage: Whatsapp users faced disruption on Wednesday night. Many users have taken the concern on X against the outage. Meta's Facebook was also down for more than 50,000 users, while Instagram was down for more than 23,000 users, according to outage tracking website Downdetector.com.Facebook & Instagram down: Users report vanishing comments, login failures – What’s going on?Facebook and Instagram users faced a widespread outage on Tuesday, affecting their ability to comment on posts, log in, and access key features. The issue, which started around 9 a.m. ET, was reported by thousands of users globally, with Downdetector recording a sharp spike in complaints. While Meta has yet to respond, users across the US and UK reported persistent disruptions, with Facebook’s website bearing the brunt of the issues. The outage follows a similar incident that hit Meta’s platforms last month.Paytm courts Swiss RE, Info Edge cofounder on startup IPOsPaytm has been waiting for more than a year for regulators to approve its acquisition of general insurance firm Raheja QBE. Now, it is on the verge of bringing on board a Swiss veteran of the insurance business as a strategic partner.
